title: Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD)
summary: Trenchless underground cable installation for road, highway, railway and river crossings.
description: We deliver advanced HDD solutions for underground fiber-optic cable installation under the leadership of a fiber-optic engineer with 25+ years of expertise. HDD minimises surface disruption while ensuring reliable and long-lasting infrastructure across road crossings, highway and railway crossings, river and canal crossings, and urban / congested areas.

processSteps.title: Route survey & planning
processSteps.description: Detailed route survey and utility identification to plan bore alignment, depth and entry/exit points.

processSteps.title: Drilling setup
processSteps.description: Advanced drilling equipment and tracking systems are positioned with safety barricades, caution boards and PPE compliance.

processSteps.title: Pilot bore
processSteps.description: Precise bore alignment and depth control under continuous quality monitoring — zero damage to existing utilities.

processSteps.title: Reaming & pull-back
processSteps.description: Bore is reamed to the required diameter and the duct/cable assembly is pulled back using high-quality bentonite drilling fluid.

processSteps.title: Quality verification
processSteps.description: Bore depth, alignment and conduit integrity are verified before backfill and surface restoration.

benefits: Ideal for road, highway, railway, river crossings
Zero damage to existing underground utilities
Faster execution in urban and congested areas

title: Manual Trenching
summary: Reliable, precise excavation for fiber laying in narrow roads, urban streets and short spans.
description: Manual trenching is ideal for narrow roads, congested areas, urban streets, residential zones and short-distance cable laying — especially where machinery access is limited or existing underground utilities prevent mechanised excavation.

processSteps.title: Route marking & utility identification
processSteps.description: Detailed route marking and identification of existing underground utilities before excavation.

processSteps.title: Controlled excavation
processSteps.description: Manual excavation with proper trench dimensions, maintaining standard depth and width.

processSteps.title: Duct / cable laying
processSteps.description: Ducts or cables are laid with proper alignment, free from kinks or sharp bends.

processSteps.title: Warning tape & protection
processSteps.description: Warning tape and protective layers are placed above the duct to flag the route for future works.

processSteps.title: Backfilling & restoration
processSteps.description: Backfilling with approved material followed by surface restoration to original condition.

benefits: Suitable for congested and narrow routes

title: Manhole Installation & Pole Erection
summary: Durable RCC manholes and aerial pole infrastructure for underground and overhead fiber networks.
description: We deliver high-quality manhole installations and pole erection as part of our underground and aerial fiber-optic infrastructure solutions — designed for long-term durability, easy maintenance access and protection of critical telecom networks.

processSteps.title: Site survey & planning
processSteps.description: Detailed inspection determines optimal location, alignment and depth based on project requirements and utility layouts.

processSteps.title: Excavation
processSteps.description: Excavation is carried out as per approved dimensions and safety standards, ensuring proper depth and width.

processSteps.title: Base preparation
processSteps.description: Strong PCC (Plain Cement Concrete) foundation provides stability and load-bearing capacity.

processSteps.title: Manhole construction
processSteps.description: Installation of precast or cast-in-situ RCC manholes with proper alignment and structural strength.

processSteps.title: Duct entry & alignment
processSteps.description: HDPE / DWC ducts are properly inserted and aligned for smooth cable routing and accessibility.

processSteps.title: Backfilling & finishing
processSteps.description: Layer-wise backfilling, heavy-duty manhole covers and surface finishing per road or terrain conditions.

benefits: Caution boards and identification markers included

title: DIT Testing Services
summary: Pressure, shuttle and sponge testing to verify duct integrity, continuity and cleanliness before cable blowing.
description: We ensure the highest quality standards in Direct In Trenching (DIT) works through comprehensive testing procedures. Our methods verify duct integrity, cleanliness and readiness for smooth fiber-optic cable installation — preventing future cable damage and maintenance issues.

processSteps.title: Pressure test
processSteps.description: Both ends of the duct are sealed and air pressure is applied via compressor. Any drop in pressure flags leakage or damage — confirming the duct is airtight, crack-free and suitable for long-term cable protection.

processSteps.title: Shuttle test
processSteps.description: A mandrel (shuttle) is pushed or blown from one end of the duct to the other. Smooth movement confirms a continuous, blockage-free, correctly-aligned duct route.

processSteps.title: Sponge test
processSteps.description: A sponge is driven through the duct using compressed air, repeated until it returns clean. Ensures a clean, dry duct — reducing friction and protecting cable during blowing.

benefits: Quality and reliability of DIT installations
Prevents future cable damage and maintenance
Documented test reports per duct section

title: Fiber Cable Blowing
summary: Fast, low-stress fiber cable installation through underground ducts using modern blowing machines.
description: We provide advanced fiber-optic cable blowing services using modern blowing machines and air compressors — ensuring fast, safe and efficient installation through underground ducts with minimal stress and maximum reliability over long distances.

processSteps.title: Duct preparation
processSteps.description: All ducts are validated using pressure, shuttle and sponge tests to ensure they are clean, dry and obstruction-free.

processSteps.title: Equipment setup
processSteps.description: High-performance cable blowing machines are installed with air compressors. Pressure and speed are tuned to duct length and route conditions.

processSteps.title: Blowing operation
processSteps.description: The fiber cable is fed into the blowing machine and pushed using compressed air. Continuous monitoring prevents jacket damage.

processSteps.title: Manhole handling
processSteps.description: At intermediate manholes, cables are guided and supported through bends and joints to maintain smooth movement.

processSteps.title: Final inspection
processSteps.description: Cable length and condition are verified end-to-end — the section is now ready for splicing and commissioning.

benefits: Reduced jacket damage vs traditional pulling

title: Splicing & Termination
summary: Fusion splicing, closure installation, FDP and FTTH FAT termination with OTDR-certified results.
description: We provide high-precision fiber-optic splicing and termination services to ensure strong, low-loss and reliable network connectivity. Our team uses advanced fusion-splicing equipment to deliver consistent performance across long-haul, FTTH and enterprise networks.

processSteps.title: Fusion splicing
processSteps.description: Advanced fusion machines join fiber cables with minimal signal loss, ensuring high-quality transmission and long-term reliability.

processSteps.title: Splicing closure installation
processSteps.description: Cables are jointed inside weatherproof closures with proper fiber routing, protection and sealing for underground or aerial use.

processSteps.title: FDP termination
processSteps.description: Termination and distribution at Fiber Distribution Points with organised cable management for easy maintenance and last-mile connectivity.

processSteps.title: FTTH FAT splicing
processSteps.description: Splicing and termination at Fiber Access Terminals — connecting drop cables to end users for stable, high-speed broadband delivery.

processSteps.title: Connector termination
processSteps.description: SC / LC connector termination, patch cord and pigtail management, with testing and labelling for easy identification.

processSteps.title: Acceptance testing
processSteps.description: Each splice is verified with OTDR and optical power meter; reports are documented for handover and future troubleshooting.

benefits: Low splice loss with high accuracy
Suitable for backbone, FTTH and campus networks
